Generate a 3D model of an octopus chef at a ramen booth

Make it in Blender, working in the current directory.
- A Blender 5 instance is running for you with no window (background mode). Use it through the `blender`
  MCP tools: run Python (`bpy`) with execute_blender_code, and look things up with the API and manual
  search tools. Blender's working directory is the current directory. The scene starts as Blender's
  default one (a cube, a camera and a light).
- There is no window to screenshot. To check your work, render it to an image file and look at the image
  (render_thumbnail_to_path, render_viewport_to_path, or a render of the scene camera to a file).
  Keep renders quick: a single tool call may take at most 5 minutes.
- Build it in Blender itself; don't write the model or the images any other way.
- Save the finished result in ./output/ (only what is in ./output/ is published):
  - the model or scene as one .glb file (glTF binary), shown on the site in an interactive 3D viewer:
    `bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=..., export_format='GLB')`, without Draco or meshopt
    compression, at most 15 MB;
  - one or more final renders as .png or .jpg, at most 2 MB each, from camera angles you choose.
  At most 8 files in all.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything (no asset
  libraries or add-ons).
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

Inspecting the Blender scene first. Then building a detailed octopus chef ramen booth.

The design features an octopus chef with eight tentacles performing ramen tasks. The booth includes a wooden counter, noren curtain, steaming broth pot, and a bowl of ramen with egg and toppings. A neon sign and warm lighting will create the night market atmosphere.

The octopus geometry will use bmesh and primitives. The mantle is a teardrop-shaped UV sphere with a reddish-orange skin. Eyes are large spheres with white sclera, black pupils, and eyelids. The chef hat is a cylinder with a puffy top. A white apron covers the front of the mantle.

Eight tentacles will be modeled as bezier curves with bevel and taper, then converted to mesh for reliable GLB export. The booth structure includes a wooden counter with overhang, a stall frame, hanging noren curtains with a circle logo, a red or indigo roof awning, a menu board, and a large stock pot on the stove.

content.thinking:
Blender 5.2.2 with EEVEE is active. I'll use EEVEE for fast renders.

I'm designing a high-quality stylized scene with a warm coral-orange octopus palette. The GLB export must stay under 15MB, so I'll balance detail against polygon count. I may split the Python script into multiple code executions to respect tool call limits.

I'll skip baked textures and use clean solid colors instead. The octopus will have a round head with a chef toque, eyes looking down at the bowl, and six tentacles arranged to suggest chopsticks, ladle, ramen, knife, and waving.

The remaining tentacles will grip the pot handle, wrap around the counter edge, and curl up holding a noren or pouring from a kettle. The camera will sit slightly low at a 3/4 angle to frame the octopus and bowl. The booth architecture uses dark wood planks for the floor, a thick front counter with a hanging cloth, vertical stall posts, and a red awning roof.

A warm shoji back panel with light behind it will frame the booth. A split noren at the front opening reveals the chef, using indigo with a white circle. A "RAMEN" sign board in 3D text sits above, plus a small red lantern. The ramen bowl is the hero prop, placed close to the camera.

The ramen bowl is a wide off-white ceramic with a blue wave ring. Its broth surface sits slightly below the rim as a golden-brown disk. Noodles appear as pale yellow bezier curves or torus knots. A half-boiled egg shows white and orange yolk. Chashu uses flattened pink-brown cylinders with fat swirls. Nori is a dark green sheet leaning against the side. Narutomaki approximates a white cylinder with a pink spiral. Scallions are small green cylinders. One tentacle tip pinches a chopstick strand lifting a noodle.

Steam will use soft white emission or translucent icospheres. Curled mesh ribbons with emission are another option.

The chef toque is a tall pleated white hat with vertical ridges and a puff top. A red bandana completes the outfit.

The chef will wear a white apron tied in front with a pocket. The octopus eyes will be large and friendly, using horizontal pupils to preserve its octopus identity. Small flattened spheres along the inner tentacles will serve as suckers for readability. I am now drafting a helper library script to organize the scene construction.

The helper library now includes a `clear()` function to delete all objects and a `mat()` function to create principled BSDF materials with color, roughness, metallic, emission, and alpha controls.

The `mat()` helper now sets emission strength and alpha. I am checking Blender 5's material blend method for transparency. I also started a `tentacle()` function that creates 3D curves with variable radii for the octopus limbs.

The tentacle helper now sets curve bevel depth and resolution, enables fill caps, and adds a Bezier spline with auto handles. It interpolates radius between start and end points along the curve length. The finished curve object is linked to the collection and will be converted to a mesh.

The tentacle helper now converts the curve to a mesh after linking it. Auto bezier handles may not produce clean shapes with dense points, so I am switching to NURBS splines for smoother limb geometry.

Suckers will be placed manually at key points along the tentacles, offset toward the body center or counter. The octopus body will use a union of two UV spheres to form a head bulb and lower sack, avoiding lattice deformation.

Smooth shading and a level-2 subdivision surface modifier will be applied to the octopus body for a clean silhouette. The mouth will be a small dark torus or curved slit with a smile arc, and two pink cheek disks will add a cute blush. A knife, cutting board, pot with broth, orange emissive flame, and hanging spoons will complete the prop set. The scene scale is set to roughly 1.6 meters for the chef, 0.7 meters for the mantle, and 2.2 by 2.4 meters for the booth. The camera will sit at (2.4, -3.2, 1.5) looking at (0, 0.2, 1.0). EEVEE lighting will use a weak warm sun.

A warm front-left area light will serve as the key, with a cool right-side fill. Point lights inside the lanterns and emission on the sign board will add sparkle. The stall will use a dark blue-purple night market palette for atmosphere, paired with warm practicals rather than a cool world. For EEVEE renders I am targeting 1280x720 or 1024x1024 resolution with 32 to 64 samples, and I will check whether Blender 5 still supports bloom in render settings or requires a compositor glare node.

A compositor glare node will add bloom without baking heavy materials. The scene origin will sit at the booth floor center so the model sits centered on the ground for default orbit views. A wooden deck plane slightly larger than the booth will anchor the GLB, with a dark stone pad or street surrounding it.

The build script will be split into four parts: utilities and booth structure, octopus body and face, food props and lighting, and final render. Smooth shading will be applied to all geometry. Tentacle curves will use a resolution of 8 and a bevel resolution of 5 to keep subdivision manageable. Suckers may be difficult to place after the curve-to-mesh conversion.

Suckers will be placed on the raw curve point list before converting to mesh. A helper function samples every other point and computes a side vector from neighboring tangents. A parallel transport frame is being drafted for 3D tentacle twisting.

The tangent vector for each point is now computed by averaging the neighboring segments. The first normal is derived from a cross product with world up, falling back to a side axis if the tangent is vertical. The next step is to propagate this frame along the curve.

The parallel transport frame is now complete. Each normal is projected onto the tangent plane and normalized to keep the orientation consistent along the curve.

Suckers will sit on the tentacle underside, aimed toward the body center or a preferred belly direction. Each sucker will be a short cylinder with a darker inner disc. I will create one prototype mesh and duplicate it via linked copies so the GLB exports cleanly as instances.

Noodles will be six thin yellow NURBS strands with one lifted by chopsticks. The egg will be a bmesh bisected UV sphere with a separate yolk. The pot will use a cylinder body, torus rim, handle tori, interior broth disk, and a leaning wooden lid. The flame will be three emissive orange cones beneath a grate.

The noren will be four cloth strips made from a subdivided plane with a wavy bottom edge, hanging from a rod. The sign board will extrude the word "RAMEN" in red or cream on a dark background with slight emission. I am checking available system fonts to replace Blender's default Bfont.

The chef hat will be built with a bmesh profile of 24 vertices, alternating outward and inward wobbles to form pleats. The cone will then be extruded upward and capped with a squashed sphere for the puff top.

The chef hat will be built in bmesh for precise control. The apron will be a bent plane with a wider bottom and a neck strap torus. The octopus arms will extend from eight origins around the head base as curved tentacles. The stall layout is now defined: the octopus sits at (0, 0.15, 1.25), the counter top is at z = 0.95, and the counter spans y = -0.35 to 0.45 and x = -1.1 to 1.1.

The customer sits at negative Y. The octopus body will sit at y = 0.35 behind the counter so its tentacles can reach over toward the customer side. The camera will look from negative Y toward positive Y.

Four specific tentacles are now planned with assigned roles:
- Noodle master: front-right, holding chopsticks above the ramen bowl
- Ladle: front-left, reaching for the pot
- Bowl present: right side, possibly holding a shaker
- Scallion: left side, resting on the cutting board

Four more tentacles are now assigned: Wave (upper right, greeting the customer), Pot grip (back left, on the pot handle), Counter lean (front center-left, draped over the counter toward the camera to reveal suckers), and Towel/stir (back right, holding a wooden spoon). Steam curls will float above the bowl and pot. The prop set also gains a condiment caddy, a stack of bowls, a chopstick holder, and a menu made from simple colored blocks instead of text. A cat character was considered but dropped as cliché.

The sign board will use "TONKOTSU" in small text and "RAMEN" in large text to avoid font rendering issues. Procedural noise textures will be avoided because glTF viewers do not support them; materials will rely on base color, roughness, metallic, emission, and normal maps so they look correct in both the GLB viewer and Blender renders.

I will generate procedural image textures in Blender using Python pixel loops. A 256 by 256 noise texture will provide subtle skin mottling for the octopus and wood grain for the counter. The noodles will remain untextured.

Auto-generated UVs on curves and primitives may be messy, so I will skip texture baking entirely. The scene will rely on solid colors and a simple wood material with roughness 0.6. The silhouette and color blocking will create a stylized Pixar still-life look.

I have a plan and am writing a comprehensive build script.

I'll write the build script to a file and execute it via Blender's exec function. It will be placed in the workspace directory and removed afterward.

I'll keep the script out of output/ and delete it after execution. I'm also designing the geometry carefully so the first render looks good.

I'm checking Blender 5.2 principled BSDF input names and EEVEE render settings to ensure the script is compatible.

I'm now defining exact meter-scale dimensions for the scene. The floor will be a 3.2 by 2.4 wood deck. The counter will measure 2.0 by 0.62 by 0.88 with a top overhang slab and toe kick. The octopus mantle will sit at (0, 0.55, 1.38) with tentacles emerging from its base.

The octopus head will be a flattened UV sphere for an iconic cartoon look. Eyes will sit on the front of the mantle with amber irises, black pupils, and small white highlights. Cute raised brow ridges will give the character a friendly expression.

The octopus will have a simple smile arc for its mouth. A toque hat will sit at the top of the head with an apron in front. Eight tentacles will attach around a circle at the base of the mantle.

I'm now defining the exact spline coordinates for three specific tentacle poses. The hello wave starts at the viewer's right and curls upward. The chopsticks reach toward a bowl in front of the octopus. A ladle is positioned over a pot on the left.

I'm now defining the remaining tentacle poses. One drapes over the counter front with suckers facing the camera. Another holds a cutting board and knife on the left side. A third stirs a pot with a spoon. I'm also adding a seventh pose.

I'm adding a seventh tentacle pose that rests on the octopus's hip with a cloth. I'm also sketching an eighth pose where a tentacle holds a soy bottle.

I realized too many crossing tentacles would look like spaghetti. I'm simplifying to a classic composition: the head and hat as the upper-center focal point, one high-waving tentacle on the right for negative space, and two foreground working tentacles for chopsticks and a ladle.

The ramen bowl will anchor the lower center-left of the frame. A pot with steam will sit to the octopus's right. Noren will frame the top without covering the face.

I'm now designing the stall structure. Two posts will sit at x=±1.15, with a beam across the top and a slightly sloped roof overhanging toward the customer. The noren rod will hang from z=1.85 down to z=1.45 so it frames the hat without covering the eyes.

I'm refining the noren placement to avoid intersecting the hat. The rod will sit at y=-0.55 and z=2.05, with panels dropping to z=1.55 so they frame the entrance without covering the cook's face. I'm also considering whether to hang the noren at the back of the stall as a backdrop instead.

The noren will sit at the front header as a shop curtain. It will run from z=2.15 down to 1.70, overlapping the hat zone but remaining visible through the gap because the hat sits on the opposite side of the stall. A "RAMEN" sign will glow warm white and red above the roof.

Orange lanterns will hang from the eaves on both sides. Two round stools will sit in front of the counter, with one pulled out slightly. A menu board will mount on the right post, and a small bowl of eggs and a stack of bowls will sit on the left back of the counter.

The tentacles will be smooth NURBS curves using order 4 with endpoint continuity. Bevel depth will scale with each spline point's radius.

The octopus body will use a coral material with roughness 0.45. Suckers will be pink-cream on the outside and darker on the inside. Each sucker mesh is a cylinder scaled to 85 percent of the tentacle radius, flattened in Z, and oriented outward from the belly.

I'm writing a helper function to orient each sucker disk's normal toward a camera-facing hint vector. This ensures the cup faces outward from the tentacle surface and remains visible.

The helper projects the camera hint onto each tangent's perpendicular plane. It normalizes the result and blends it with the previous normal using a 0.65 weight for smooth continuity. If the projection collapses, it falls back to a world axis.

I will keep the suckers as separate objects rather than joining them into one mesh per material. The chopsticks will be two thin cylinders at the tentacle tip, angled downward into the bowl with a noodle looping up. The ladle will be a sphere cut with a handle cylinder, wrapped by the tentacle tip.

A knife will sit on the cutting board with a tentacle resting near chopped scallions. I will check for object intersections before rendering and fix any that appear.

The camera will be a 50mm lens at (1.85, -2.9, 1.55) aimed at (0.0, 0.15, 1.25). I plan two final renders: a hero 3/4 view and a closer shot of the bowl and face. A side view may be added as well. The output will be two or three PNGs plus one glb file.

Render resolution will be 1280x960 or 1440x1080 with 48 samples. JPEG compression will be used if PNG files become too large.

A back wall will block the void behind the stall. It will use warm plaster with a wooden frame and a glowing shoji window. AgX is the view transform. I'll set the look and catch errors. Raytracing will be off for thumbnails. Fast GI with ambient occlusion will be used instead. TAA samples are 48. Shadows are enabled.

The box helper scales vertices by the desired dimensions after measuring bounds. A cylinder along Z will use a bmesh cone with capped ends. Torus geometry will be created by spinning a circle around the Z axis.

The torus helper will create a circle offset by the major radius, rotate it into place, and spin it around the Z axis. If the spin operation fails or is too complex, I'll fall back to simpler cylinder geometry for rings and brims.

A hemisphere bowl will be created from a UV sphere. The top half will be removed and the remaining geometry solidified to form the pot body. A rim torus will be added for the edge. A broth disc will sit inside.

The coil helper will trace a spiral path with slight vertical variation and cap it with a tube mesh. Overlapping coils plus irregular arcs will form the noodle pile. arguments.content:
"""Stylized octopus chef at a night-market ramen booth. Built entirely in bpy."""
import glob
import math
import os
import traceback

import bmesh
import bpy
from mathutils import Matrix, Vector

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

COUNTER_TOP = 0.96
OCTO = Vector((0.0, 0.70, 1.50))
HEAD_R = 0.40

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# low-level helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def srgb(c):
    def f(u):
        return u / 12.92 if u <= 0.04045 else ((u + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4

    return tuple(f(float(x)) for x in c)


def link(obj):
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


def shade(obj, smooth=True):
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = smooth
    obj.data.update()


def finish(obj, mat, smooth=True):
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if obj.type == "MESH":
        shade(obj, smooth)
    return obj


def new_mesh(name, bm, mat=None, smooth=True):
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.normal_update()
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    if mat:
        finish(obj, mat, smooth)
    elif smooth:
        shade(obj, True)
    return obj


def wipe():
    for obj in list(bpy.data.objects):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
    for coll in (
        bpy.data.meshes,
        bpy.data.curves,
        bpy.data.materials,
        bpy.data.lights,
        bpy.data.cameras,
    ):
        for block in list(coll):
            coll.remove(block)


def make_mat(
    name,
    color,
    rough=0.5,
    metal=0.0,
    emit=0.0,
    emit_color=None,
    alpha=1.0,
    specular=0.5,
    coat=0.0,
):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = next(n for n in mat.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    col = srgb(color)
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*col, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    bsdf.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = specular
    if coat and "Coat Weight" in bsdf.inputs:
        bsdf.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
        if "Coat Roughness" in bsdf.inputs:
            bsdf.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = 0.15
    if emit > 0:
        ec = srgb(emit_color or color)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*ec, 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emit
    if alpha < 1.0:
        bsdf.inputs["Alpha"].default_value = alpha
        if hasattr(mat, "blend_method"):
            try:
                mat.blend_method = "BLEND"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
        if hasattr(mat, "surface_render_method"):
            try:
                mat.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
    mat.use_backface_culling = False
    return mat


def cube(name, dims, loc, mat=None, rot=None, bevel=0.0, smooth=False):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    xs = [v.co.x for v in bm.verts]
    extent = max(xs) - min(xs)
    s = 1.0 / extent
    for v in bm.verts:
        v.co.x *= dims[0] * s
        v.co.y *= dims[1] * s
        v.co.z *= dims[2] * s
    if bevel > 0:
        try:
            bmesh.ops.bevel(
                bm,
                geom=list(bm.edges),
                offset=bevel,
                segments=2,
                profile=0.5,
                affect="EDGES",
                clamp_overlap=True,
            )
        except (TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            pass
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=smooth or bevel > 0)
    obj.location = loc
    if rot:
        obj.rotation_euler = rot
    return obj

def catmull(points, samples=5):
    pts = [Vector(p) for p in points]
    if len(pts) < 2:
        return pts
    ext = [pts[0]] + pts + [pts[-1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(1, len(ext) - 2):
        p0, p1, p2, p3 = ext[i - 1], ext[i], ext[i + 1], ext[i + 2]
        steps = samples if i < len(ext) - 3 else samples + 1
        for s in range(steps):
            t = s / samples
            t2 = t * t
            t3 = t2 * t
            q = 0.5 * (
                (2 * p1)
                + (-p0 + p2) * t
                + (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3) * t2
                + (-p0 + 3 * p1 - 3 * p2 + p3) * t3
            )
            out.append(q)
    return out


def _curve_to_mesh(name, points, radii, mat, cyclic=False, bevel_res=4, smooth=True):
    curve = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_c", "CURVE")
    curve.dimensions = "3D"
    curve.resolution_u = 2
    curve.bevel_resolution = bevel_res
    curve.bevel_depth = 1.0
    curve.use_fill_caps = not cyclic
    spline = curve.splines.new("POLY")
    spline.use_cyclic_u = cyclic
    spline.points.add(len(points) - 1)
    for i, p in enumerate(points):
        spline.points[i].co = (float(p.x), float(p.y), float(p.z), 1.0)
        spline.points[i].radius = float(radii[i])
    holder = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_src", curve)
    link(holder)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(holder.evaluated_get(deps), depsgraph=deps)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    obj.matrix_world = holder.matrix_world.copy()
    finish(obj, mat, smooth)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(holder, do_unlink=True)
    if curve.users == 0:
        bpy.data.curves.remove(curve)
    return obj


def tube(name, points, r0, r1, mat, bevel_res=4, samples=5):
    sampled = catmull(points, samples=samples)
    n = max(1, len(sampled) - 1)
    radii = []
    for i in range(len(sampled)):
        t = i / n
        base = r0 * (1.0 - t) + r1 * t
        radii.append(base * (1.0 + 0.06 * math.sin(t * math.pi)))
    return _curve_to_mesh(name, sampled, radii, mat, cyclic=False, bevel_res=bevel_res)


def ring(name, center, radius, tube_r, mat, axis="Z", segments=28, bevel_res=3):
    center = Vector(center)
    pts = []
    for i in range(segments):
        a = i / segments * math.tau
        if axis == "Z":
            pts.append(center + Vector((math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius, 0.0)))
        elif axis == "X":
            pts.append(center + Vector((0.0, math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius)))
        else:
            pts.append(center + Vector((math.cos(a) * radius, 0.0, math.sin(a) * radius)))
    radii = [tube_r] * len(pts)
    return _curve_to_mesh(name, pts, radii, mat, cyclic=True, bevel_res=bevel_res)


def belly_normals(pts, hint):
    hint = Vector(hint).normalized()
    tangents = []
    for i in range(len(pts)):
        if i == 0:
            t = pts[1] - pts[0]
        elif i == len(pts) - 1:
            t = pts[-1] - pts[-2]
        else:
            t = pts[i + 1] - pts[i - 1]
        tangents.append(t.normalized() if t.length > 1e-8 else Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    normals = []
    for t in tangents:
        n = hint - t * hint.dot(t)
        if n.length < 1e-6:
            alt = Vector((0, 0, 1))
            n = alt - t * alt.dot(t)
        if n.length < 1e-6:
            n = Vector((1, 0, 0))
        normals.append(n.normalized())
    return tangents, normals


def basis_z(z, twist=0.0):
    z = Vector(z).normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(z.dot(up)) > 0.92:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    x = up.cross(z).normalized()
    y = z.cross(x).normalized()
    if twist:
        c, s = math.cos(twist), math.sin(twist)
        x, y = x * c + y * s, -x * s + y * c
    return x, y, z


def set_basis(obj, loc, x, y, z, scale):
    sx, sy, sz = scale
    obj.matrix_world = Matrix(
        (
            (x.x * sx, y.x * sy, z.x * sz, loc.x),
            (x.y * sx, y.y * sy, z.y * sz, loc.y),
            (x.z * sx, y.z * sy, z.z * sz, loc.z),
            (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
        )
    )


def load_font(patterns):
    for pat in patterns:
        for path in glob.glob(pat):
            try:
                return bpy.data.fonts.load(path), path
            except (RuntimeError, OSError):
                continue
    return None, None


def text_mesh(name, body, loc, size, mat, font=None, extrude=0.012, rot=None):
    curve = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_t", "FONT")
    curve.body = body
    curve.align_x = "CENTER"
    curve.align_y = "CENTER"
    curve.size = size
    curve.extrude = extrude
    curve.bevel_depth = size * 0.012
    curve.bevel_resolution = 1
    curve.resolution_u = 6
    if font:
        curve.font = font
    holder = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_src", curve)
    link(holder)
    holder.location = loc
    if rot:
        holder.rotation_euler = rot
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(holder.evaluated_get(deps), depsgraph=deps)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    obj.matrix_world = holder.matrix_world.copy()
    finish(obj, mat, smooth=True)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(holder, do_unlink=True)
    if curve.users == 0:
        bpy.data.curves.remove(curve)
    return obj

        cube(
            f"Plank_{i}",

    bm = bmesh.new()
    verts = []
    for iz in range(nz + 1):
        row = []
        tz = iz / nz
        for ix in range(nx + 1):
            tx = ix / nx
            x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * tx
            # gentle billow toward the street and a soft hem
            billow = math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.035 * tz
            sway = math.sin(tx * math.pi * 2 + iz) * 0.008 * tz
            z = top - length * tz
            if iz == nz:
                z += math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.025
            row.append(bm.verts.new((x, y - billow + sway, z)))
        verts.append(row)
    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    for iz in range(nz):
        for ix in range(nx):
            bm.faces.new((verts[iz][ix], verts[iz][ix + 1], verts[iz + 1][ix + 1], verts[iz + 1][ix]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    bmesh.ops.solidify(bm, geom=list(bm.faces), thickness=0.006)
    new_mesh(name, bm, M["indigo"], smooth=True)


def build_stool(M, origin, name, yaw=0.0):
    x, y, z = origin
    seat = cyl(name + "_seat", 0.18, 0.06, (x, y, 0.50), M["stool"], segments=20)
    seat.rotation_euler[2] = yaw
    cyl(name + "_pad", 0.16, 0.02, (x, y, 0.535), M["red"], segments=20)
    for k in range(4):
        a = yaw + k * math.tau / 4 + 0.4
        lx = x + math.cos(a) * 0.12
        ly = y + math.sin(a) * 0.12
        # splay outward
        cyl(name + f"_leg{k}", 0.018, 0.46, (lx * 0.15 + x * 0.85, ly * 0.15 + y * 0.85, 0.25), M["wood_d"], segments=8)
        # place leg at the splay position properly
        leg = bpy.data.objects[name + f"_leg{k}"]
        leg.location = ((x + lx) / 2, (y + ly) / 2, 0.26)
        leg.rotation_euler = (math.radians(8) * math.cos(a), math.radians(-8) * math.sin(a), 0)
    ring(name + "_foot", (x, y, 0.16), 0.13, 0.012, M["wood_d"], segments=20, bevel_res=2)

        v.co.x *= 1.06

    # siphon — the octopus tell, a short tube under the eyes

    ring(
        "Bandana",

        0.30,
        0.028,
        M["red"],
        axis="Z",
        segments=28,
        bevel_res=3,
    )
    # knot
    sphere("BandanaKnot", 0.045, OCTO + Vector((0.30, -0.08, -0.20)), M["red"], scale=(1.0, 0.8, 0.7), segments=12, rings=8)

    # apron bib
    bm = bmesh.new()
    w, h = 0.50, 0.42
    top_z = OCTO.z - 0.28
    y = OCTO.y - 0.34
    grid = []
    for iz in range(6):
        row = []
        for ix in range(6):
            tx = ix / 5
            tz = iz / 5
            x = (tx - 0.5) * w * (0.72 + 0.28 * tz)
            z = top_z - tz * h
            yy = y - math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.03 * tz
            row.append(bm.verts.new((x, yy, z)))
        grid.append(row)
    for iz in range(5):
        for ix in range(5):
            bm.faces.new((grid[iz][ix], grid[iz][ix + 1], grid[iz + 1][ix + 1], grid[iz + 1][ix]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    bmesh.ops.solidify(bm, geom=list(bm.faces), thickness=0.01)
    new_mesh("Apron", bm, M["apron"], smooth=True)
    # pocket
    cube("Pocket", (0.14, 0.02, 0.10), (0.08, y - 0.02, top_z - 0.30), M["hat"], bevel=0.003)
    # straps over the shoulders
    for sx in (-0.12, 0.12):
        tube(
            f"Strap_{sx}",
            [
                (sx * 0.4, y, top_z),
                (sx * 1.6, OCTO.y - 0.1, OCTO.z - 0.05),
                (sx * 2.2, OCTO.y + 0.05, OCTO.z + 0.05),
            ],
            0.012,
            0.012,
            M["apron"],
            bevel_res=2,
            samples=3,
        )

    # tentacles
    sucker_master, hole_master = make_sucker_masters(M)
    tentacles = tentacle_specs()
    for spec in tentacles:
        sampled = catmull(spec["pts"], samples=4)
        n = max(1, len(sampled) - 1)
        radii = []
        for i in range(len(sampled)):
            t = i / n
            radii.append(spec["r0"] * (1 - t) + spec["r1"] * t)
        _curve_to_mesh(spec["name"], sampled, radii, M["skin"], bevel_res=4)
        _, normals = belly_normals(sampled, spec["hint"])
        # walk along and drop suckers
        dist = 0.0
        next_at = 0.06
        for i in range(1, len(sampled) - 2):
            step = (sampled[i] - sampled[i - 1]).length
            dist += step
            t = i / n
            if t < 0.12 or t > 0.9:
                continue
            if dist < next_at:
                continue
            next_at = dist + 0.075
            r = radii[i]
            loc = sampled[i] + normals[i] * (r * 0.82)
            x, yb, z = basis_z(normals[i], twist=i * 0.9)
            cup = sucker_master.copy()
            cup.name = spec["name"] + f"_cup{i}"
            link(cup)
            set_basis(cup, loc, x, yb, z, (r * 0.72, r * 0.72, r * 0.28))
            hole = hole_master.copy()
            hole.name = spec["name"] + f"_hole{i}"
            link(hole)
            set_basis(hole, loc + normals[i] * (r * 0.12), x, yb, z, (r * 0.38, r * 0.38, r * 0.16))
    # retire masters (mesh data stays with the copies)
    for master in (sucker_master, hole_master):
        mesh = master.data
        bpy.data.objects.remove(master, do_unlink=True)
        mesh.use_fake_user = True

def build_toque(M, base):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    segs = 28
    heights = [0.0, 0.04, 0.28, 0.46]
    rings = []
    for hi, h in enumerate(heights):
        ring_v = []
        for i in range(segs):
            a = i / segs * math.tau
            pleat = 1.0 + 0.07 * math.cos(a * 10)
            if hi == 0:
                pleat = 1.0
            r = 0.20 * pleat
            if hi == len(heights) - 1:
                r *= 0.92
            ring_v.append(bm.verts.new((math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r, h)))
        rings.append(ring_v)
    for hi in range(len(heights) - 1):
        for i in range(segs):
            j = (i + 1) % segs
            bm.faces.new((rings[hi][i], rings[hi][j], rings[hi + 1][j], rings[hi + 1][i]))
    # top cap
    top = []
    for i in range(segs):
        a = i / segs * math.tau
        top.append(bm.verts.new((math.cos(a) * 0.04, math.sin(a) * 0.04, heights[-1] + 0.01)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % segs
        bm.faces.new((rings[-1][i], rings[-1][j], top[j], top[i]))
    center = bm.verts.new((0, 0, heights[-1] + 0.02))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % segs
        bm.faces.new((top[i], top[j], center))
    # bottom cap
    center_b = bm.verts.new((0, 0, 0))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % segs
        bm.faces.new((rings[0][j], rings[0][i], center_b))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    hat = new_mesh("Toque", bm, M["hat"], smooth=True)
    hat.location = (base.x, base.y - 0.02, base.z)
    # puff
    sphere("ToquePuff", 0.16, (base.x, base.y - 0.02, base.z + 0.48), M["hat"], scale=(1.15, 1.15, 0.72), segments=24, rings=16)
    ring("ToqueBrim", (base.x, base.y - 0.02, base.z + 0.02), 0.205, 0.018, M["hat"], segments=24, bevel_res=2)

import glob

import bmesh
import bpy

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# constants

COUNTER_TOP = 0.96
OCTO = Vector((0.0, 0.70, 1.50))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# low-level helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def srgb(c):
    def f(u):
        return u / 12.92 if u <= 0.04045 else ((u + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4

    return tuple(f(float(x)) for x in c)


def link(obj):
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


def shade(obj, smooth=True):
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = smooth
    obj.data.update()


def finish(obj, mat, smooth=True):
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if obj.type == "MESH":
        shade(obj, smooth)
    return obj


def new_mesh(name, bm, mat=None, smooth=True):
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.normal_update()
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    if mat:
        finish(obj, mat, smooth)
    elif smooth:
        shade(obj, True)
    return obj


def wipe():
    for obj in list(bpy.data.objects):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
    for coll in (
        bpy.data.meshes,
        bpy.data.curves,
        bpy.data.materials,
        bpy.data.lights,
        bpy.data.cameras,
    ):
        for block in list(coll):
            coll.remove(block)


def make_mat(
    name,
    color,
    rough=0.5,
    metal=0.0,
    emit=0.0,
    emit_color=None,
    alpha=1.0,
    specular=0.5,
    coat=0.0,
):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = next(n for n in mat.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    col = srgb(color)
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*col, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    bsdf.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = specular
    if coat and "Coat Weight" in bsdf.inputs:
        bsdf.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
        if "Coat Roughness" in bsdf.inputs:
            bsdf.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = 0.15
    if emit > 0:
        ec = srgb(emit_color or color)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*ec, 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emit
    if alpha < 1.0:
        bsdf.inputs["Alpha"].default_value = alpha
        if hasattr(mat, "blend_method"):
            try:
                mat.blend_method = "BLEND"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
        if hasattr(mat, "surface_render_method"):
            try:
                mat.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
    mat.use_backface_culling = False
    return mat


def cube(name, dims, loc, mat=None, rot=None, bevel=0.0, smooth=False):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    xs = [v.co.x for v in bm.verts]
    extent = max(xs) - min(xs)
    s = 1.0 / extent
    for v in bm.verts:
        v.co.x *= dims[0] * s
        v.co.y *= dims[1] * s
        v.co.z *= dims[2] * s
    if bevel > 0:
        try:
            bmesh.ops.bevel(
                bm,
                geom=list(bm.edges),
                offset=bevel,
                segments=2,
                profile=0.5,
                affect="EDGES",
                clamp_overlap=True,
            )
        except (TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            pass
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=smooth or bevel > 0)
    obj.location = loc
    if rot:
        obj.rotation_euler = rot
    return obj


def cyl(name, radius, depth, loc, mat=None, segments=24, rot=None, smooth=True):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
    )
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=smooth)
    obj.location = loc
    if rot:
        obj.rotation_euler = rot
    return obj


def sphere(name, radius, loc, mat=None, segments=32, rings=16, scale=None, rot=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=rings, radius=radius)
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=True)
    obj.location = loc
    if scale:
        obj.scale = scale
    if rot:
        obj.rotation_euler = rot
    return obj


def look_at(obj, target, up="Y"):
    direction = Vector(target) - obj.location
    obj.rotation_euler = direction.to_track_quat("-Z", up).to_euler()


def catmull(points, samples=5):
    pts = [Vector(p) for p in points]
    if len(pts) < 2:
        return pts
    ext = [pts[0]] + pts + [pts[-1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(1, len(ext) - 2):
        p0, p1, p2, p3 = ext[i - 1], ext[i], ext[i + 1], ext[i + 2]
        steps = samples if i < len(ext) - 3 else samples + 1
        for s in range(steps):
            t = s / samples
            t2 = t * t
            t3 = t2 * t
            q = 0.5 * (
                (2 * p1)
                + (-p0 + p2) * t
                + (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3) * t2
                + (-p0 + 3 * p1 - 3 * p2 + p3) * t3
            )
            out.append(q)
    return out


def _curve_to_mesh(name, points, radii, mat, cyclic=False, bevel_res=4, smooth=True):
    curve = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_c", "CURVE")
    curve.dimensions = "3D"
    curve.resolution_u = 2
    curve.bevel_resolution = bevel_res
    curve.bevel_depth = 1.0
    curve.use_fill_caps = not cyclic
    spline = curve.splines.new("POLY")
    spline.use_cyclic_u = cyclic
    spline.points.add(len(points) - 1)
    for i, p in enumerate(points):
        spline.points[i].co = (float(p.x), float(p.y), float(p.z), 1.0)
        spline.points[i].radius = float(radii[i])
    holder = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_src", curve)
    link(holder)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(holder.evaluated_get(deps), depsgraph=deps)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    obj.matrix_world = holder.matrix_world.copy()
    finish(obj, mat, smooth)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(holder, do_unlink=True)
    if curve.users == 0:
        bpy.data.curves.remove(curve)
    return obj


def tube(name, points, r0, r1, mat, bevel_res=4, samples=5):
    sampled = catmull(points, samples=samples)
    n = max(1, len(sampled) - 1)
    radii = []
    for i in range(len(sampled)):
        t = i / n
        base = r0 * (1.0 - t) + r1 * t
        radii.append(base * (1.0 + 0.06 * math.sin(t * math.pi)))
    return _curve_to_mesh(name, sampled, radii, mat, cyclic=False, bevel_res=bevel_res)


def ring(name, center, radius, tube_r, mat, axis="Z", segments=28, bevel_res=3):
    center = Vector(center)
    pts = []
    for i in range(segments):
        a = i / segments * math.tau
        if axis == "Z":
            pts.append(center + Vector((math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius, 0.0)))
        elif axis == "X":
            pts.append(center + Vector((0.0, math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius)))
        else:
            pts.append(center + Vector((math.cos(a) * radius, 0.0, math.sin(a) * radius)))
    radii = [tube_r] * len(pts)
    return _curve_to_mesh(name, pts, radii, mat, cyclic=True, bevel_res=bevel_res)


def belly_normals(pts, hint):
    hint = Vector(hint).normalized()
    tangents = []
    for i in range(len(pts)):
        if i == 0:
            t = pts[1] - pts[0]
        elif i == len(pts) - 1:
            t = pts[-1] - pts[-2]
        else:
            t = pts[i + 1] - pts[i - 1]
        tangents.append(t.normalized() if t.length > 1e-8 else Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    normals = []
    for t in tangents:
        n = hint - t * hint.dot(t)
        if n.length < 1e-6:
            alt = Vector((0, 0, 1))
            n = alt - t * alt.dot(t)
        if n.length < 1e-6:
            n = Vector((1, 0, 0))
        normals.append(n.normalized())
    return tangents, normals


def basis_z(z, twist=0.0):
    z = Vector(z).normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(z.dot(up)) > 0.92:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    x = up.cross(z).normalized()
    y = z.cross(x).normalized()
    if twist:
        c, s = math.cos(twist), math.sin(twist)
        x, y = x * c + y * s, -x * s + y * c
    return x, y, z


def set_basis(obj, loc, x, y, z, scale):
    sx, sy, sz = scale
    obj.matrix_world = Matrix(
        (
            (x.x * sx, y.x * sy, z.x * sz, loc.x),
            (x.y * sx, y.y * sy, z.y * sz, loc.y),
            (x.z * sx, y.z * sy, z.z * sz, loc.z),
            (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
        )
    )


def load_font(patterns):
    for pat in patterns:
        for path in glob.glob(pat):
            try:
                return bpy.data.fonts.load(path), path
            except (RuntimeError, OSError):
                continue
    return None, None


def text_mesh(name, body, loc, size, mat, font=None, extrude=0.012, rot=None):
    curve = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_t", "FONT")
    curve.body = body
    curve.align_x = "CENTER"
    curve.align_y = "CENTER"
    curve.size = size
    curve.extrude = extrude
    curve.bevel_depth = size * 0.012
    curve.bevel_resolution = 1
    curve.resolution_u = 6
    if font:
        curve.font = font
    holder = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_src", curve)
    link(holder)
    holder.location = loc
    if rot:
        holder.rotation_euler = rot
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(holder.evaluated_get(deps), depsgraph=deps)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    obj.matrix_world = holder.matrix_world.copy()
    finish(obj, mat, smooth=True)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(holder, do_unlink=True)
    if curve.users == 0:
        bpy.data.curves.remove(curve)
    return obj


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# scene parts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_materials():
    M = {}

def build_floor(M):
    colors = [M["plank_a"], M["plank_b"], M["plank_c"], M["plank_b"], M["plank_a"]]
    # deck footprint
    x0, x1 = -1.35, 1.35
    y0, y1 = -1.25, 1.45
    n = 7
    gap = 0.012
    width = (x1 - x0 - gap * (n - 1)) / n
    for i in range(n):
        x = x0 + width / 2 + i * (width + gap)
        cube(
            f"Plank_{i}",
            (width, y1 - y0, 0.07),
            (x, (y0 + y1) / 2, 0.035),
            colors[i % len(colors)],
            bevel=0.004,
        )
    # dark alley skirt, kept tight so the viewer frames the stall
    cube("Skirt", (2.9, 2.9, 0.04), (0.0, 0.1, 0.012), M["wood_d"], bevel=0.0, smooth=False)

    return roof


def make_noren(M, x0, x1, y, top, length, name):
    nx, nz = 7, 9
    bm = bmesh.new()
    verts = []
    for iz in range(nz + 1):
        row = []
        tz = iz / nz
        for ix in range(nx + 1):
            tx = ix / nx
            x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * tx
            # gentle billow toward the street and a soft hem
            billow = math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.035 * tz
            sway = math.sin(tx * math.pi * 2 + iz) * 0.008 * tz
            z = top - length * tz
            if iz == nz:
                z += math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.025
            row.append(bm.verts.new((x, y - billow + sway, z)))
        verts.append(row)
    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    for iz in range(nz):
        for ix in range(nx):
            bm.faces.new((verts[iz][ix], verts[iz][ix + 1], verts[iz + 1][ix + 1], verts[iz + 1][ix]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    bmesh.ops.solidify(bm, geom=list(bm.faces), thickness=0.006)
    new_mesh(name, bm, M["indigo"], smooth=True)


def build_stool(M, origin, name, yaw=0.0):
    x, y, z = origin
    seat = cyl(name + "_seat", 0.18, 0.06, (x, y, 0.50), M["stool"], segments=20)
    seat.rotation_euler[2] = yaw
    cyl(name + "_pad", 0.16, 0.02, (x, y, 0.535), M["red"], segments=20)
    for k in range(4):
        a = yaw + k * math.tau / 4 + 0.4
        lx = x + math.cos(a) * 0.12
        ly = y + math.sin(a) * 0.12
        # splay outward
        cyl(name + f"_leg{k}", 0.018, 0.46, (lx * 0.15 + x * 0.85, ly * 0.15 + y * 0.85, 0.25), M["wood_d"], segments=8)
        # place leg at the splay position properly
        leg = bpy.data.objects[name + f"_leg{k}"]
        leg.location = ((x + lx) / 2, (y + ly) / 2, 0.26)
        leg.rotation_euler = (math.radians(8) * math.cos(a), math.radians(-8) * math.sin(a), 0)
    ring(name + "_foot", (x, y, 0.16), 0.13, 0.012, M["wood_d"], segments=20, bevel_res=2)


def build_octopus(M):
    # mantle
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=48, v_segments=32, radius=HEAD_R)
    for v in bm.verts:
        # organic: fuller cheeks, softer flattened underside
        if v.co.z < 0:
            v.co.z *= 0.78
        v.co.x *= 1.06
        v.co.y *= 0.96
        # slight forward bulge for the face
        if v.co.y < 0 and v.co.z > -0.05:
            v.co.y *= 1.06
    obj = new_mesh("Mantle", bm, M["skin"], smooth=True)
    obj.location = OCTO

    # belly patch
    sphere(
        "Belly",
        0.18,
        OCTO + Vector((0.0, -0.22, -0.12)),
        M["skin_lite"],
        scale=(1.15, 0.45, 0.85),
        segments=24,
        rings=12,
    )

    # spots
    spot_dirs = [
        Vector((0.55, -0.55, 0.45)),
        Vector((-0.6, -0.4, 0.5)),
        Vector((0.85, -0.15, 0.15)),
        Vector((-0.8, -0.2, 0.05)),
        Vector((0.2, -0.35, 0.75)),
        Vector((-0.25, -0.2, 0.8)),
        Vector((0.45, 0.15, 0.7)),
    ]
    for i, d in enumerate(spot_dirs):
        d = d.normalized()
        # approximate surface of the scaled mantle
        surf = Vector((d.x * HEAD_R * 1.06, d.y * HEAD_R * 0.98, d.z * HEAD_R * (0.78 if d.z < 0 else 1.0)))
        sphere(
            f"Spot_{i}",
            0.055,
            OCTO + surf * 0.98,
            M["skin_deep"],
            scale=(1.0, 0.45, 1.0),
            segments=12,
            rings=8,
        )

    # eyes — sit on the front of the mantle, aimed a little down toward the bowl
    def place_eye(name, side):
        direction = Vector((0.20 * side, -0.86, 0.08)).normalized()
        center = OCTO + Vector(
            (
                direction.x * HEAD_R * 1.08,
                direction.y * HEAD_R * 1.02,
                direction.z * HEAD_R * 1.05 + 0.04,
            )
        )
        sphere(name + "_white", 0.095, center, M["eye_w"], scale=(1.0, 0.62, 1.05), segments=28, rings=16)
        iris_c = center + Vector((0.012 * side, -0.045, -0.012))
        sphere(name + "_iris", 0.048, iris_c, M["iris"], scale=(1.05, 0.55, 1.0), segments=20, rings=12)
        pupil_c = iris_c + Vector((0.01 * side, -0.028, -0.006))
        sphere(name + "_pupil", 0.026, pupil_c, M["pupil"], scale=(1.55, 0.45, 0.7), segments=16, rings=10)
        catch_c = iris_c + Vector((-0.018 * side, -0.03, 0.02))
        sphere(name + "_catch", 0.012, catch_c, M["catch"], segments=10, rings=8)
        # brow, skin colored, raised at the outer corner
        brow = cyl(
            name + "_brow",
            0.016,
            0.13,
            center + Vector((0.02 * side, -0.02, 0.09)),
            M["skin_deep"],
            segments=10,
            rot=(0, math.radians(70 * side + 18 * side), math.radians(90)),
        )
        brow.scale = (1.0, 1.4, 1.0)
        # blush
        sphere(
            name + "_blush",
            0.04,
            center + Vector((0.04 * side, -0.01, -0.07)),
            M["blush"],
            scale=(1.2, 0.35, 0.7),
            segments=12,
            rings=8,
        )

    place_eye("EyeL", -1)
    place_eye("EyeR", 1)

    # smile
    mouth_c = OCTO + Vector((0.0, -0.40, -0.06))
    smile = []
    for i in range(9):
        t = (i / 8) * 2 - 1  # -1..1
        smile.append(
            (
                mouth_c.x + t * 0.11,
                mouth_c.y - 0.02 + (t * t) * 0.015,
                mouth_c.z - 0.045 + (1 - t * t) * -0.01,
            )
        )
    tube("Smile", smile, 0.012, 0.012, M["mouth"], bevel_res=3, samples=3)
    # little open mouth
    sphere("Mouth", 0.028, mouth_c + Vector((0, -0.015, -0.055)), M["mouth"], scale=(1.3, 0.45, 0.7), segments=12, rings=8)

    # siphon — the octopus tell, a short tube under the eyes
    siphon = cyl(
        "Siphon",
        0.035,
        0.10,
        OCTO + Vector((0.22, -0.28, -0.02)),
        M["skin"],
        segments=12,
        rot=(math.radians(70), math.radians(20), 0),
    )
    sphere("SiphonTip", 0.04, OCTO + Vector((0.26, -0.34, -0.06)), M["skin_lite"], scale=(1.0, 0.8, 0.7), segments=12, rings=8)

    # chef toque
    hat_base = OCTO + Vector((0.0, 0.0, HEAD_R * 0.92))
    build_toque(M, hat_base)

    # bandana at the "neck"
    ring(
        "Bandana",
        OCTO + Vector((0.0, -0.02, -0.22)),
        0.30,
        0.028,
        M["red"],
        axis="Z",
        segments=28,
        bevel_res=3,
    )
    # knot
    sphere("BandanaKnot", 0.045, OCTO + Vector((0.30, -0.08, -0.20)), M["red"], scale=(1.0, 0.8, 0.7), segments=12, rings=8)

    # apron bib
    bm = bmesh.new()
    w, h = 0.50, 0.42
    top_z = OCTO.z - 0.28
    y = OCTO.y - 0.34
    grid = []
    for iz in range(6):
        row = []
        for ix in range(6):
            tx = ix / 5
            tz = iz / 5
            x = (tx - 0.5) * w * (0.72 + 0.28 * tz)
            z = top_z - tz * h
            yy = y - math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.03 * tz
            row.append(bm.verts.new((x, yy, z)))
        grid.append(row)
    for iz in range(5):
        for ix in range(5):
            bm.faces.new((grid[iz][ix], grid[iz][ix + 1], grid[iz + 1][ix + 1], grid[iz + 1][ix]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    bmesh.ops.solidify(bm, geom=list(bm.faces), thickness=0.01)
    new_mesh("Apron", bm, M["apron"], smooth=True)
    # pocket
    cube("Pocket", (0.14, 0.02, 0.10), (0.08, y - 0.02, top_z - 0.30), M["hat"], bevel=0.003)
    # straps over the shoulders
    for sx in (-0.12, 0.12):
        tube(
            f"Strap_{sx}",
            [
                (sx * 0.4, y, top_z),
                (sx * 1.6, OCTO.y - 0.1, OCTO.z - 0.05),
                (sx * 2.2, OCTO.y + 0.05, OCTO.z + 0.05),
            ],
            0.012,
            0.012,
            M["apron"],
            bevel_res=2,
            samples=3,
        )

    # tentacles
    sucker_master, hole_master = make_sucker_masters(M)
    tentacles = tentacle_specs()
    for spec in tentacles:
        sampled = catmull(spec["pts"], samples=4)
        n = max(1, len(sampled) - 1)
        radii = []
        for i in range(len(sampled)):
            t = i / n
            radii.append(spec["r0"] * (1 - t) + spec["r1"] * t)
        _curve_to_mesh(spec["name"], sampled, radii, M["skin"], bevel_res=4)
        _, normals = belly_normals(sampled, spec["hint"])
        # walk along and drop suckers
        dist = 0.0
        next_at = 0.06
        for i in range(1, len(sampled) - 2):
            step = (sampled[i] - sampled[i - 1]).length
            dist += step
            t = i / n
            if t < 0.12 or t > 0.9:
                continue
            if dist < next_at:
                continue
            next_at = dist + 0.075
            r = radii[i]
            loc = sampled[i] + normals[i] * (r * 0.82)
            x, yb, z = basis_z(normals[i], twist=i * 0.9)
            cup = sucker_master.copy()
            cup.name = spec["name"] + f"_cup{i}"
            link(cup)
            set_basis(cup, loc, x, yb, z, (r * 0.72, r * 0.72, r * 0.28))
            hole = hole_master.copy()
            hole.name = spec["name"] + f"_hole{i}"
            link(hole)
            set_basis(hole, loc + normals[i] * (r * 0.12), x, yb, z, (r * 0.38, r * 0.38, r * 0.16))
    # retire masters (mesh data stays with the copies)
    for master in (sucker_master, hole_master):
        mesh = master.data
        bpy.data.objects.remove(master, do_unlink=True)
        mesh.use_fake_user = True


def make_sucker_masters(M):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, segments=14, radius1=1.0, radius2=1.0, depth=1.0
    )
    cup = new_mesh("SuckerMaster", bm, M["sucker"], smooth=True)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, segments=12, radius1=1.0, radius2=0.65, depth=1.0
    )
    hole = new_mesh("SuckerHoleMaster", bm, M["sucker_in"], smooth=True)
    return cup, hole

def build_toque(M, base):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    segs = 28
    heights = [0.0, 0.04, 0.28, 0.46]
    rings = []
    for hi, h in enumerate(heights):
        ring_v = []
        for i in range(segs):
            a = i / segs * math.tau
            pleat = 1.0 + 0.07 * math.cos(a * 10)
            if hi == 0:
                pleat = 1.0
            r = 0.20 * pleat
            if hi == len(heights) - 1:
                r *= 0.92
            ring_v.append(bm.verts.new((math.cos(a) * r, math.sin(a) * r, h)))
        rings.append(ring_v)
    for hi in range(len(heights) - 1):
        for i in range(segs):
            j = (i + 1) % segs
            bm.faces.new((rings[hi][i], rings[hi][j], rings[hi + 1][j], rings[hi + 1][i]))
    # top cap
    top = []
    for i in range(segs):
        a = i / segs * math.tau
        top.append(bm.verts.new((math.cos(a) * 0.04, math.sin(a) * 0.04, heights[-1] + 0.01)))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % segs
        bm.faces.new((rings[-1][i], rings[-1][j], top[j], top[i]))
    center = bm.verts.new((0, 0, heights[-1] + 0.02))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % segs
        bm.faces.new((top[i], top[j], center))
    # bottom cap
    center_b = bm.verts.new((0, 0, 0))
    for i in range(segs):
        j = (i + 1) % segs
        bm.faces.new((rings[0][j], rings[0][i], center_b))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    hat = new_mesh("Toque", bm, M["hat"], smooth=True)
    hat.location = (base.x, base.y - 0.02, base.z)
    # puff
    sphere("ToquePuff", 0.16, (base.x, base.y - 0.02, base.z + 0.48), M["hat"], scale=(1.15, 1.15, 0.72), segments=24, rings=16)
    ring("ToqueBrim", (base.x, base.y - 0.02, base.z + 0.02), 0.205, 0.018, M["hat"], segments=24, bevel_res=2)

def hemisphere_obj(name, radius, mat, segments=24, rings=12):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=rings, radius=radius)
    doomed = [v for v in bm.verts if v.co.z > 0.001]
    bmesh.ops.delete(bm, geom=doomed, context="VERTS")
    # cap the cut
    boundary = [e for e in bm.edges if e.is_boundary]
    if boundary:
        bmesh.ops.holes_fill(bm, edges=boundary)
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    return new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=True)


def build_bowl(M, loc, name, radius=0.15, height_scale=0.62):
    """Hemisphere bowl sitting with its foot on loc (x, y, z)."""
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=32, v_segments=16, radius=radius)
    doomed = [v for v in bm.verts if v.co.z > 0.01]
    bmesh.ops.delete(bm, geom=doomed, context="VERTS")
    for v in bm.verts:
        v.co.z *= height_scale
    bmesh.ops.solidify(bm, geom=list(bm.faces), thickness=0.012)
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    # after scaling z, bottom is at -radius*height_scale
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, M["bowl"], smooth=True)
    foot = radius * height_scale
    obj.location = (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + foot)
    # blue band
    ring(
        name + "_band",
        (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + foot * 0.55),
        radius * 0.92,
        0.008,
        M["bowl_blue"],
        segments=28,
        bevel_res=2,
    )
    ring(
        name + "_rim",
        (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + foot + 0.004),
        radius * 0.98,
        0.008,
        M["bowl"],
        segments=32,
        bevel_res=2,
    )
    return obj


def noodle_coil(M, center, radius, name, phase=0.0):
    cx, cy, cz = center
    pts = []
    turns = 2.4
    steps = 18
    for i in range(steps):
        t = i / (steps - 1)
        a = phase + t * turns * math.tau
        rr = radius * (0.45 + 0.55 * t)
        pts.append(
            (
                cx + math.cos(a) * rr,
                cy + math.sin(a) * rr * 0.82,
                cz + math.sin(a * 2.0) * 0.01 + t * 0.012,
            )
        )
    tube(name, pts, 0.008, 0.007, M["noodle"], bevel_res=2, samples=2)


def build_lights_and_cameras():
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.render.engine = "BLENDER_EEVEE"
    scene.render.resolution_x = 1200
    scene.render.resolution_y = 900
    scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
    scene.render.film_transparent = False
    ee = scene.eevee
    ee.taa_render_samples = 48
    ee.taa_samples = 16
    ee.use_shadows = True
    ee.use_raytracing = False
    try:
        ee.use_fast_gi = True
    except (AttributeError, TypeError):
        pass

    world = scene.world
    if world is None:
        world = bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
        scene.world = world
    world.use_nodes = True
    bg = world.node_tree.nodes.get("Background")
    if bg:
        bg.inputs["Color"].default_value = (*srgb((0.05, 0.055, 0.09)), 1.0)
        bg.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 0.45
    scene.view_settings.view_transform = "AgX"
    scene.view_settings.exposure = 0.25
    for look in ("AgX - Medium High Contrast", "AgX - Base Contrast"):

            scene.view_settings.look = look

def srgb(c):
    def f(u):
        return u / 12.92 if u <= 0.04045 else ((u + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4

    return tuple(f(float(x)) for x in c)


def link(obj):
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj


def shade(obj, smooth=True):
    for p in obj.data.polygons:
        p.use_smooth = smooth
    obj.data.update()


def finish(obj, mat, smooth=True):
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)
    if obj.type == "MESH":
        shade(obj, smooth)
    return obj


def new_mesh(name, bm, mat=None, smooth=True):
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    bm.normal_update()
    bm.to_mesh(mesh)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    if mat:
        finish(obj, mat, smooth)
    elif smooth:
        shade(obj, True)
    return obj


def wipe():
    for obj in list(bpy.data.objects):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
    for coll in (
        bpy.data.meshes,
        bpy.data.curves,
        bpy.data.materials,
        bpy.data.lights,
        bpy.data.cameras,
    ):
        for block in list(coll):
            coll.remove(block)


def make_mat(
    name,
    color,
    rough=0.5,
    metal=0.0,
    emit=0.0,
    emit_color=None,
    alpha=1.0,
    specular=0.5,
    coat=0.0,
):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = next(n for n in mat.node_tree.nodes if n.type == "BSDF_PRINCIPLED")
    col = srgb(color)
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*col, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    bsdf.inputs["Specular IOR Level"].default_value = specular
    if coat and "Coat Weight" in bsdf.inputs:
        bsdf.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
        if "Coat Roughness" in bsdf.inputs:
            bsdf.inputs["Coat Roughness"].default_value = 0.15
    if emit > 0:
        ec = srgb(emit_color or color)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*ec, 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emit
    if alpha < 1.0:
        bsdf.inputs["Alpha"].default_value = alpha
        if hasattr(mat, "blend_method"):
            try:
                mat.blend_method = "BLEND"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
        if hasattr(mat, "surface_render_method"):
            try:
                mat.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
    mat.use_backface_culling = False
    return mat


def cube(name, dims, loc, mat=None, rot=None, bevel=0.0, smooth=False):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    xs = [v.co.x for v in bm.verts]
    extent = max(xs) - min(xs)
    s = 1.0 / extent
    for v in bm.verts:
        v.co.x *= dims[0] * s
        v.co.y *= dims[1] * s
        v.co.z *= dims[2] * s
    if bevel > 0:
        try:
            bmesh.ops.bevel(
                bm,
                geom=list(bm.edges),
                offset=bevel,
                segments=2,
                profile=0.5,
                affect="EDGES",
                clamp_overlap=True,
            )
        except (TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            pass
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=smooth or bevel > 0)
    obj.location = loc
    if rot:
        obj.rotation_euler = rot
    return obj


def cyl(name, radius, depth, loc, mat=None, segments=24, rot=None, smooth=True):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm,
        cap_ends=True,
        cap_tris=False,
        segments=segments,
        radius1=radius,
        radius2=radius,
        depth=depth,
    )
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=smooth)
    obj.location = loc
    if rot:
        obj.rotation_euler = rot
    return obj


def sphere(name, radius, loc, mat=None, segments=32, rings=16, scale=None, rot=None):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=segments, v_segments=rings, radius=radius)
    obj = new_mesh(name, bm, mat, smooth=True)
    obj.location = loc
    if scale:
        obj.scale = scale
    if rot:
        obj.rotation_euler = rot

def look_at(obj, target, up="Y"):
    direction = Vector(target) - obj.location
    obj.rotation_euler = direction.to_track_quat("-Z", up).to_euler()


def catmull(points, samples=5):
    pts = [Vector(p) for p in points]
    if len(pts) < 2:
        return pts
    ext = [pts[0]] + pts + [pts[-1]]
    out = []
    for i in range(1, len(ext) - 2):
        p0, p1, p2, p3 = ext[i - 1], ext[i], ext[i + 1], ext[i + 2]
        steps = samples if i < len(ext) - 3 else samples + 1
        for s in range(steps):
            t = s / samples
            t2 = t * t
            t3 = t2 * t
            q = 0.5 * (
                (2 * p1)
                + (-p0 + p2) * t
                + (2 * p0 - 5 * p1 + 4 * p2 - p3) * t2
                + (-p0 + 3 * p1 - 3 * p2 + p3) * t3
            )
            out.append(q)
    return out


def _curve_to_mesh(name, points, radii, mat, cyclic=False, bevel_res=4, smooth=True):
    curve = bpy.data.curves.new(name + "_c", "CURVE")
    curve.dimensions = "3D"
    curve.resolution_u = 2
    curve.bevel_resolution = bevel_res
    curve.bevel_depth = 1.0
    curve.use_fill_caps = not cyclic
    spline = curve.splines.new("POLY")
    spline.use_cyclic_u = cyclic
    spline.points.add(len(points) - 1)
    for i, p in enumerate(points):
        spline.points[i].co = (float(p.x), float(p.y), float(p.z), 1.0)
        spline.points[i].radius = float(radii[i])
    holder = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_src", curve)
    link(holder)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(holder.evaluated_get(deps), depsgraph=deps)
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    link(obj)
    obj.matrix_world = holder.matrix_world.copy()
    finish(obj, mat, smooth)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(holder, do_unlink=True)
    if curve.users == 0:
        bpy.data.curves.remove(curve)
    return obj


def tube(name, points, r0, r1, mat, bevel_res=4, samples=5):
    sampled = catmull(points, samples=samples)
    n = max(1, len(sampled) - 1)
    radii = []
    for i in range(len(sampled)):
        t = i / n
        base = r0 * (1.0 - t) + r1 * t
        radii.append(base * (1.0 + 0.06 * math.sin(t * math.pi)))
    return _curve_to_mesh(name, sampled, radii, mat, cyclic=False, bevel_res=bevel_res)


def ring(name, center, radius, tube_r, mat, axis="Z", segments=28, bevel_res=3):
    center = Vector(center)
    pts = []
    for i in range(segments):
        a = i / segments * math.tau
        if axis == "Z":
            pts.append(center + Vector((math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius, 0.0)))
        elif axis == "X":
            pts.append(center + Vector((0.0, math.cos(a) * radius, math.sin(a) * radius)))
        else:
            pts.append(center + Vector((math.cos(a) * radius, 0.0, math.sin(a) * radius)))
    radii = [tube_r] * len(pts)
    return _curve_to_mesh(name, pts, radii, mat, cyclic=True, bevel_res=bevel_res)


def belly_normals(pts, hint):
    hint = Vector(hint).normalized()
    tangents = []
    for i in range(len(pts)):
        if i == 0:
            t = pts[1] - pts[0]
        elif i == len(pts) - 1:
            t = pts[-1] - pts[-2]
        else:
            t = pts[i + 1] - pts[i - 1]
        tangents.append(t.normalized() if t.length > 1e-8 else Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    normals = []
    for t in tangents:
        n = hint - t * hint.dot(t)
        if n.length < 1e-6:
            alt = Vector((0, 0, 1))
            n = alt - t * alt.dot(t)
        if n.length < 1e-6:
            n = Vector((1, 0, 0))
        normals.append(n.normalized())
    return tangents, normals


def basis_z(z, twist=0.0):
    z = Vector(z).normalized()
    up = Vector((0, 0, 1))
    if abs(z.dot(up)) > 0.92:
        up = Vector((0, 1, 0))
    x = up.cross(z).normalized()
    y = z.cross(x).normalized()
    if twist:
        c, s = math.cos(twist), math.sin(twist)
        x, y = x * c + y * s, -x * s + y * c
    return x, y, z


def set_basis(obj, loc, x, y, z, scale):
    sx, sy, sz = scale
    obj.matrix_world = Matrix(
        (
            (x.x * sx, y.x * sy, z.x * sz, loc.x),
            (x.y * sx, y.y * sy, z.y * sz, loc.y),
            (x.z * sx, y.z * sy, z.z * sz, loc.z),
            (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0),
        )
    )


def load_font(patterns):
    for pat in patterns:
        for path in glob.glob(pat):
            try:
                return bpy.data.fonts.load(path), path
            except (RuntimeError, OSError):
                continue
    return None, None

    holder = bpy.data.objects.new(name + "_src", curve)

    finish(obj, mat, smooth=True)
    bpy.data.objects.remove(holder, do_unlink=True)

    colors = [M["plank_a"], M["plank_b"], M["plank_c"], M["plank_b"], M["plank_a"]]
    # deck footprint
    x0, x1 = -1.35, 1.35
    y0, y1 = -1.25, 1.45
    n = 7
    gap = 0.012
    width = (x1 - x0 - gap * (n - 1)) / n
    for i in range(n):
        x = x0 + width / 2 + i * (width + gap)
        cube(
            f"Plank_{i}",
            (width, y1 - y0, 0.07),
            (x, (y0 + y1) / 2, 0.035),
            colors[i % len(colors)],
            bevel=0.004,
        )
    # dark alley skirt, kept tight so the viewer frames the stall
    cube("Skirt", (2.9, 2.9, 0.04), (0.0, 0.1, 0.012), M["wood_d"], bevel=0.0, smooth=False)

def make_noren(M, x0, x1, y, top, length, name):
    nx, nz = 7, 9
    bm = bmesh.new()
    verts = []
    for iz in range(nz + 1):
        row = []
        tz = iz / nz
        for ix in range(nx + 1):
            tx = ix / nx
            x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * tx
            # gentle billow toward the street and a soft hem
            billow = math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.035 * tz
            sway = math.sin(tx * math.pi * 2 + iz) * 0.008 * tz
            z = top - length * tz
            if iz == nz:
                z += math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.025
            row.append(bm.verts.new((x, y - billow + sway, z)))
        verts.append(row)
    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    for iz in range(nz):
        for ix in range(nx):
            bm.faces.new((verts[iz][ix], verts[iz][ix + 1], verts[iz + 1][ix + 1], verts[iz + 1][ix]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    bmesh.ops.solidify(bm, geom=list(bm.faces), thickness=0.006)
    new_mesh(name, bm, M["indigo"], smooth=True)


def build_stool(M, origin, name, yaw=0.0):
    x, y, z = origin
    seat = cyl(name + "_seat", 0.18, 0.06, (x, y, 0.50), M["stool"], segments=20)
    seat.rotation_euler[2] = yaw
    cyl(name + "_pad", 0.16, 0.02, (x, y, 0.535), M["red"], segments=20)
    for k in range(4):
        a = yaw + k * math.tau / 4 + 0.4
        lx = x + math.cos(a) * 0.12
        ly = y + math.sin(a) * 0.12
        # splay outward
        cyl(name + f"_leg{k}", 0.018, 0.46, (lx * 0.15 + x * 0.85, ly * 0.15 + y * 0.85, 0.25), M["wood_d"], segments=8)
        # place leg at the splay position properly
        leg = bpy.data.objects[name + f"_leg{k}"]
        leg.location = ((x + lx) / 2, (y + ly) / 2, 0.26)
        leg.rotation_euler = (math.radians(8) * math.cos(a), math.radians(-8) * math.sin(a), 0)
    ring(name + "_foot", (x, y, 0.16), 0.13, 0.012, M["wood_d"], segments=20, bevel_res=2)


def build_octopus(M):
    # mantle
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=48, v_segments=32, radius=HEAD_R)
    for v in bm.verts:
        # organic: fuller cheeks, softer flattened underside
        if v.co.z < 0:
            v.co.z *= 0.78
        v.co.x *= 1.06
        v.co.y *= 0.96
        # slight forward bulge for the face
        if v.co.y < 0 and v.co.z > -0.05:
            v.co.y *= 1.06
    obj = new_mesh("Mantle", bm, M["skin"], smooth=True)
    obj.location = OCTO

    # belly patch
    sphere(
        "Belly",
        0.18,
        OCTO + Vector((0.0, -0.22, -0.12)),
        M["skin_lite"],
        scale=(1.15, 0.45, 0.85),
        segments=24,
        rings=12,
    )

    # spots
    spot_dirs = [
        Vector((0.55, -0.55, 0.45)),
        Vector((-0.6, -0.4, 0.5)),
        Vector((0.85, -0.15, 0.15)),
        Vector((-0.8, -0.2, 0.05)),
        Vector((0.2, -0.35, 0.75)),
        Vector((-0.25, -0.2, 0.8)),
        Vector((0.45, 0.15, 0.7)),
    ]
    for i, d in enumerate(spot_dirs):
        d = d.normalized()
        # approximate surface of the scaled mantle
        surf = Vector((d.x * HEAD_R * 1.06, d.y * HEAD_R * 0.98, d.z * HEAD_R * (0.78 if d.z < 0 else 1.0)))
        sphere(
            f"Spot_{i}",
            0.055,
            OCTO + surf * 0.98,
            M["skin_deep"],
            scale=(1.0, 0.45, 1.0),
            segments=12,
            rings=8,
        )

    # eyes — sit on the front of the mantle, aimed a little down toward the bowl
    def place_eye(name, side):
        direction = Vector((0.20 * side, -0.86, 0.08)).normalized()
        center = OCTO + Vector(
            (
                direction.x * HEAD_R * 1.08,
                direction.y * HEAD_R * 1.02,
                direction.z * HEAD_R * 1.05 + 0.04,
            )
        )
        sphere(name + "_white", 0.095, center, M["eye_w"], scale=(1.0, 0.62, 1.05), segments=28, rings=16)
        iris_c = center + Vector((0.012 * side, -0.045, -0.012))
        sphere(name + "_iris", 0.048, iris_c, M["iris"], scale=(1.05, 0.55, 1.0), segments=20, rings=12)
        pupil_c = iris_c + Vector((0.01 * side, -0.028, -0.006))
        sphere(name + "_pupil", 0.026, pupil_c, M["pupil"], scale=(1.55, 0.45, 0.7), segments=16, rings=10)
        catch_c = iris_c + Vector((-0.018 * side, -0.03, 0.02))
        sphere(name + "_catch", 0.012, catch_c, M["catch"], segments=10, rings=8)
        # brow, skin colored, raised at the outer corner
        brow = cyl(
            name + "_brow",
            0.016,
            0.13,
            center + Vector((0.02 * side, -0.02, 0.09)),
            M["skin_deep"],
            segments=10,
            rot=(0, math.radians(70 * side + 18 * side), math.radians(90)),
        )
        brow.scale = (1.0, 1.4, 1.0)
        # blush
        sphere(
            name + "_blush",
            0.04,
            center + Vector((0.04 * side, -0.01, -0.07)),
            M["blush"],
            scale=(1.2, 0.35, 0.7),
            segments=12,
            rings=8,
        )

    place_eye("EyeL", -1)
    place_eye("EyeR", 1)

    # smile
    mouth_c = OCTO + Vector((0.0, -0.40, -0.06))
    smile = []
    for i in range(9):
        t = (i / 8) * 2 - 1  # -1..1
        smile.append(
            (
                mouth_c.x + t * 0.11,
                mouth_c.y - 0.02 + (t * t) * 0.015,
                mouth_c.z - 0.045 + (1 - t * t) * -0.01,
            )
        )
    tube("Smile", smile, 0.012, 0.012, M["mouth"], bevel_res=3, samples=3)
    # little open mouth
    sphere("Mouth", 0.028, mouth_c + Vector((0, -0.015, -0.055)), M["mouth"], scale=(1.3, 0.45, 0.7), segments=12, rings=8)

    # siphon — the octopus tell, a short tube under the eyes
    siphon = cyl(
        "Siphon",
        0.035,
        0.10,
        OCTO + Vector((0.22, -0.28, -0.02)),
        M["skin"],
        segments=12,
        rot=(math.radians(70), math.radians(20), 0),
    )
    sphere("SiphonTip", 0.04, OCTO + Vector((0.26, -0.34, -0.06)), M["skin_lite"], scale=(1.0, 0.8, 0.7), segments=12, rings=8)

    # chef toque
    hat_base = OCTO + Vector((0.0, 0.0, HEAD_R * 0.92))
    build_toque(M, hat_base)

    # bandana at the "neck"
    ring(
        "Bandana",
        OCTO + Vector((0.0, -0.02, -0.22)),
        0.30,
        0.028,
        M["red"],
        axis="Z",
        segments=28,
        bevel_res=3,
    )
    # knot
    sphere("BandanaKnot", 0.045, OCTO + Vector((0.30, -0.08, -0.20)), M["red"], scale=(1.0, 0.8, 0.7), segments=12, rings=8)

    # apron bib
    bm = bmesh.new()
    w, h = 0.50, 0.42
    top_z = OCTO.z - 0.28
    y = OCTO.y - 0.34
    grid = []
    for iz in range(6):
        row = []
        for ix in range(6):
            tx = ix / 5
            tz = iz / 5
            x = (tx - 0.5) * w * (0.72 + 0.28 * tz)
            z = top_z - tz * h
            yy = y - math.sin(tx * math.pi) * 0.03 * tz
            row.append(bm.verts.new((x, yy, z)))
        grid.append(row)
    for iz in range(5):
        for ix in range(5):
            bm.faces.new((grid[iz][ix], grid[iz][ix + 1], grid[iz + 1][ix + 1], grid[iz + 1][ix]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=list(bm.faces))
    bmesh.ops.solidify(bm, geom=list(bm.faces), thickness=0.01)
    new_mesh("Apron", bm, M["apron"], smooth=True)
    # pocket
    cube("Pocket", (0.14, 0.02, 0.10), (0.08, y - 0.02, top_z - 0.30), M["hat"], bevel=0.003)
    # straps over the shoulders
    for sx in (-0.12, 0.12):
        tube(
            f"Strap_{sx}",
            [
                (sx * 0.4, y, top_z),
                (sx * 1.6, OCTO.y - 0.1, OCTO.z - 0.05),
                (sx * 2.2, OCTO.y + 0.05, OCTO.z + 0.05),
            ],
            0.012,
            0.012,
            M["apron"],
            bevel_res=2,
            samples=3,
        )

    # tentacles
    sucker_master, hole_master = make_sucker_masters(M)
    tentacles = tentacle_specs()
    for spec in tentacles:
        sampled = catmull(spec["pts"], samples=4)
        n = max(1, len(sampled) - 1)
        radii = []
        for i in range(len(sampled)):
            t = i / n
            radii.append(spec["r0"] * (1 - t) + spec["r1"] * t)
        _curve_to_mesh(spec["name"], sampled, radii, M["skin"], bevel_res=4)
        _, normals = belly_normals(sampled, spec["hint"])
        # walk along and drop suckers
        dist = 0.0
        next_at = 0.06
        for i in range(1, len(sampled) - 2):
            step = (sampled[i] - sampled[i - 1]).length
            dist += step
            t = i / n
            if t < 0.12 or t > 0.9:
                continue
            if dist < next_at:
                continue
            next_at = dist + 0.075
            r = radii[i]
            loc = sampled[i] + normals[i] * (r * 0.82)
            x, yb, z = basis_z(normals[i], twist=i * 0.9)
            cup = sucker_master.copy()
            cup.name = spec["name"] + f"_cup{i}"
            link(cup)
            set_basis(cup, loc, x, yb, z, (r * 0.72, r * 0.72, r * 0.28))
            hole = hole_master.copy()
            hole.name = spec["name"] + f"_hole{i}"
            link(hole)
            set_basis(hole, loc + normals[i] * (r * 0.12), x, yb, z, (r * 0.38, r * 0.38, r * 0.16))
    # retire masters (mesh data stays with the copies)
    for master in (sucker_master, hole_master):
        mesh = master.data
        bpy.data.objects.remove(master, do_unlink=True)
        mesh.use_fake_user = True


def make_sucker_masters(M):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, segments=14, radius1=1.0, radius2=1.0, depth=1.0
    )
    cup = new_mesh("SuckerMaster", bm, M["sucker"], smooth=True)
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(
        bm, cap_ends=True, segments=12, radius1=1.0, radius2=0.65, depth=1.0
    )
    hole = new_mesh("SuckerHoleMaster", bm, M["sucker_in"], smooth=True)
    return cup, hole
